scope: Selected filters in the measured Ti64 cleanup examples.

filters.purpose: Read the full paper-linked grayscale raster without cropping; preserve uint8 source pixels and use uncalibrated pixel coordinates.
Copy inclusive X/Y pixels 4..599 into Ti64 while retaining the full Source Image.
Copy cropped uint8 intensity to float32 so later image processing does not round intermediate values to integers.
Normalize the common cropped float32 input to the 0..1 range before subsequent comparison branches.
Summarize normalized intensity over every cropped pixel without a feature index or mask.
Save source, prepared crop, floating-point arrays, and summary as the shared checkpoint.
Load the preparation checkpoint with both image geometries, the original intensity, and the common float32 UnitIntensity baseline.
Median of a 3 by 3 XY neighborhood, including repeated edge values; compare isolated-intensity suppression from the common input.
Discrete Gaussian with variance 1 pixel squared per XY axis; retain a separate output from the original UnitIntensity.
